title: Basanti runtime QA and five-project open-source review
selection_basis: Five established open-source projects relevant to BIM geometry, linked selection, camera state, SI quantities and construction scheduling. This is not a global ranking.
method: Read pinned upstream source files and primary documentation, implement independent repairs, add regression tests, rebuild all pages, then verify preview and deployed interfaces.

projects.principle: Check SI units and closed solid volumes after reopening IFC.
projects.application: Independent gross mesh volumes and bounds are compared against the reopened IFC for every closed non-rebar product. Curves and thickness-unassigned elements remain unmeasured.

projects.principle: Keep element identity and highlighting consistent across views; selection should not require camera movement.
projects.application: Retained shared element IDs, prevented orbit drags from selecting, and added clear selection / Escape across the workbench plan, model and table.

projects.principle: Capture and restore camera state when temporarily changing the inspection context.
projects.application: Context visibility preserves the current camera; isolation saves and restores position, orientation, target, projection and zoom.

projects.principle: Treat a quantity as a numeric value with a dimension and a defined validity boundary.
projects.application: Reject nonfinite or incomplete scenarios, fractional coat counts, sloping beams and unmeasured solid heights. Do not treat unknowns as numeric zero. Conservatively withhold unsupported overlapping-slab unions.

projects.principle: Validate dependency relations and distinguish planning logic from site approval.
projects.application: Reject duplicate IDs/relations and unknown overrides. Blank durations cannot become zero. Explicit zero-day milestones, full fixed work labels, zoom and predecessor/successor navigation improve the planning programme.

integration: No upstream code was copied or newly vendored; no new runtime dependency was introduced. The existing pinned IfcOpenShell export dependency is retained. Upstream licenses are recorded for review, not relicensed by this report.
limitations: Gross IFC geometry checks do not validate net contractual takeoff quantities or design adequacy.
The slab overlap guard conservatively checks overlapping bounding regions and withholds unsupported cases; it is not a polygon boolean solver.
Programme durations are whole calendar days with finish-to-start links; no resource levelling, holidays or actual progress is claimed.
Bar fabrication lengths, covers, laps, anchorage, unresolved source conflicts, structural and MEP approvals remain unconfirmed.
Cloud browser QA may use the shared-geometry SVG fallback where hardware WebGL is unavailable; native Revit import is not tested.

The full source export has 145 checked solids and 12 withheld gross volumes: eight unassigned-thickness footing outlines, two railing curves and two stair meshes failing strict closure. Provisional stair takeoff is not an independently verified closed IFC solid volume.
